Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

DIMENSIONS FOR 
MOUNTED WHEELS AND POINTS 

(First Revision) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions for mounted wheels and points. 

2. Classification —The mounted wheels and points shall be classified into three groups, designated 
as 'A', ' B ' and ' W. 



Grit Size 

36/46 
54/60 
80/100 



3. 


Grade — 


Shall be as under 

Grade 

Coarse 
Medium 
Fine 


4. 


Material 




4.1 


Abrasive 


— Silicon carbide 


5. 


Dimensions 



5.1 The dimensions for mounted wheels and points of Group ' A V B f and ' W ' shall be as given in 
Tables 1, 2 and 3 respectively. 

6. Spindle 

6.1 The diameter of spindle for mounted wheels and points shall be 6 mm and 3 mm for Groups 'A' 
and 'B' respectively. The spindle diameter for Group *W shall be as given in Table 3. 

6.2 The length of the spindle shall be 25 mm or 40 mm. 

6.3 The tolerance on the diameter of the spindles shall be 'hH' according to IS : 919-1963 
1 Recommendations for limits and fits for engineering '. 

6.4 Spindles shall be manufactured from steel having minimum tensile strength of 700 MPa* and 
plated with nickel and chromium. The electroplated coatings shall conform to service Grade No. 1 
with Designation SNi10b Cr r of IS: 1068-1968 ' Electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on 
iron and steel (first revision)' with the proviso that P — or d — nickel and f — chromium may be 
substituted for b — nickel and r — chromium respectively or otherwise suitably treated to prevent 
corrosion. 

7. Designation — A mounted wheel or point having nominal size symbol A14, spindle 
diameter 6 mm, spindle diameter 25 mm, made from aluminium oxide of 54/60 grit size (Medium) 
and conforming to this standard shall be designate-d as: 

Mounted Wheel/Point A14/6X25 IS : 3300 Aluminium Oxide — Medium 

8. Marking — The carton containing the mounted wheels and points shall be marked with the 

following: 



CO 


a) Commonly used name; 






< 


b) Nominal size ( that is, symbol guen for each type ); 




c) Spindle diameter; 




d) Spindle length; 




e) Type of abrasive; 




f) Grain size of abrasive, namely coarse, medium or fine; and 




g) Manufacturer's name or 


trade mark. 




*1MPa=* 0*1 kgf/mm 2 (approx). 




Adopted 29 April 1980

Example: 

A mounted wheel/point having nominal size symbol A21 with spindle diameter 6 mm, 
spindle length 25 mm, made from aluminium oxide of 54/60 grit size (Medium) shall 
be marked as: 

Mounted Wheel/Point A21/6X25, Aluminium Oxide — Medium 

8.1 ISI Certification Mar king — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1965. The abrasives sectional committee reviewed 
the standard and decided to revise it in view of the experience gained by the industry during the 
course of time, and to switch over to the metric sizes and also to align it with the work done at 
ISO level. 

In this standard, mounted wheels and points covered, are those which are being extensively 
used in the industry for a variety of applications, such as demurring, smoothening and polishing of 
tools, dies, metal patterns and moulds. These are also used in the finishing of inaccessible regions 
of intricate castings and similar jobs, along the seams and fillets of large welded parts. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from 
ISO 2933-1974 ' Bonded abrasive products — grinding wheel dimensions (Part 3)' issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization. 



Printed at Neelkamal Printers, Delhi, India
